## About
Southwest Brake & Alignments is an old school alignment and brake shop on the Pan Am Expressway in San Antonio. If your steering wheel pulls to one side or your tires are wearing unevenly, bring it by and our technicians will take a look.
We work on a wide range of vehicles, including trucks, classic cars, trailers, motor homes and older models with I-beam suspensions. Every alignment, balancing and truing job is done with the tires on the vehicle.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 296 reviews. Give us a call or come see us any weekday.

## Services
- Wheel alignment: We align your wheels so the car tracks straight and you have full control, whether it's a daily driver, a truck or a trailer.
- Brake service: Brake work for vehicle owners around San Antonio and across Texas.
- Tire truing and balancing: Truing and balancing help your tires last longer and give you a smoother ride.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on classic cars and trucks?
A: Yes. We work on a wide range of vehicles, including trucks, classic cars and trailers.

Q: My car shakes on the highway. Can you help?
A: Don't ignore it. Bring it by and our technicians will work on getting you rolling smooth again with balancing and tire truing.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday to Friday and closed on weekends.
